name: google-analytics-data-api
description: Reads Google Analytics 4 reports (active users, traffic sources, devices, pages) from the Analytics Data API runReport endpoint. Read-only. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.

risk.read: external Google Analytics 4 (GA4) API reads performed by the legacy connector via a Tier-2 hook
